name: Quebec: public health coverage for newcomers
name_fr: Québec : assurance maladie publique pour les nouveaux arrivants
description: Who is covered by Régie de l'assurance maladie du Québec (RAMQ) — health insurance plan by immigration status, any waiting period for newcomers, how to apply, the public drug-coverage model and the share of adults with a regular health care provider.

attributes.plan_name: Régie de l'assurance maladie du Québec (RAMQ) — health insurance plan
attributes.legal_status: in force (eligibility rules as published on the access date)

eligibility_by_status.citizen: Eligible as a resident (residency and presence rules apply).
eligibility_by_status.permanent_resident: Eligible once settled in Québec; immigrants must be present 183 days or more in the first 12 months of eligibility (RAMQ, via search extract).
eligibility_by_status.work_permit_holder: Temporary workers may be eligible under conditions not captured here (RAMQ pages blocked); persons staying more than 6 months must hold a valid authorization of stay.
eligibility_by_status.study_permit_holder: Generally not eligible unless covered by a social security agreement or another exception (not confirmed in this pass).
eligibility_by_status.visitor: Visitors and tourists are expressly excluded in the AB, MB, NB and PE material read; treat visitors as not covered everywhere and confirm locally.

attributes.status_dependency: Which rule applies depends on the user's immigration status, which is unknown (USER-PROFILE.md: 'Citizenship(s) and current country of residence', 'Existing Canadian status or application').

newcomer_waiting_period.arriving_from_outside_canada: Up to 3 months from registration (applies even to Canadian citizens arriving from abroad). Exceptions include children under 18 (waiting period abolished for all children), people from countries with a social security agreement with Québec, refugees and protected persons, last-resort social-assistance recipients and some scholarship holders.

attributes.how_to_apply: Register with RAMQ once in Québec with all documents; the waiting period starts at registration. Private insurance recommended for the gap.
attributes.drug_coverage_model: Public Prescription Drug Insurance Plan for residents without private coverage, seniors 65+ and last-resort assistance recipients: income-based premium, monthly deductible and 35% co-insurance (PMPRB 2020/21 summary). Whether people with access to a group plan must join it was not verified in this pass; premium amounts not captured.

regular_provider.source: CIHI indicator 'Canadians With a Primary Health Care Provider', Statistics Canada CCHS

sources.publisher: Régie de l'assurance maladie du Québec

sources.title: Canadians With a Primary Health Care Provider — indicator data table (data updated October 2026); underlying data: Statistics Canada, Canadian Community Health Survey, Annual Component
sources.methodology: Weighted percent of adults 18+ reporting a regular/primary health care provider (family doctor, nurse practitioner or other); 95% confidence interval given. 2025 adult questions were harmonized, so compare with earlier years with caution.

sources.title: Public Drug Plan Designs, 2021/22 edition (describes 2020/21 plan designs; page modified 2024-01-30)

verification.notes: Provincial page(s) fetched directly where status is 'verified'; otherwise some content came from search-engine extracts of official pages (403 or bot-check on fetch). Regular-provider figures parsed from CIHI's published data table.

limitations: Eligibility text summarises official pages and is not legal advice; temporary-status rules change often. Drug-plan designs are from PMPRB's 2020/21 summary and may be out of date. 'Without a regular provider' is 100 minus the CIHI share (simple arithmetic).
